zh-CN.summary: 注重隐私的元搜索引擎。

zh-TW.summary: 注重隱私的整合搜尋引擎。

zh-CN.summary: SearXNG 不用 root 权限运行，根文件系统只读，没有服务账号令牌，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。只有 Traefik 能通过 HTTPS 连到它。向外的网络流量没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: SearXNG 不用 root 權限執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有服務帳號權杖，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。只有 Traefik 能透過 HTTPS 連到它。往外的網路流量沒有限制。

zh-CN.mitigation: 公开实例模式是关闭的，基于 Valkey 的流量限制器也没有开。请只用于私人、查询量小的搜索。要对外公开之前，先在 ingress 加上登录验证和流量限制。
zh-CN.risk: 搜索如果对外公开，可能被人滥用，上游的搜索引擎也可能限速或封禁这台服务器。

zh-TW.mitigation: 公開實例模式是關閉的，用 Valkey 的流量限制器也沒有開。請只用在私人、查詢量小的搜尋。要對外公開之前，先在 ingress 加上登入驗證和流量限制。
zh-TW.risk: 搜尋如果對外公開，可能被人濫用，上游的搜尋引擎也可能限速或封鎖這台伺服器。

risks.mitigation: Public instance mode is off, and the Valkey-backed rate limiter is not turned on. Use this instance for private, low-volume search. Before you publish it, add sign-in and rate limiting at the ingress.
risks.risk: If the search is open to the public, others can abuse it, and the upstream search engines may slow down or block this server.

zh-CN.mitigation: 这个模板不限制向外的网络流量。请读过你开启的每个搜索引擎的隐私政策。
zh-CN.risk: SearXNG 要连到公共网络上的许多搜索引擎，所以你的搜索关键词会离开这个集群。

zh-TW.mitigation: 這個範本不限制往外的網路流量。請讀過你開啟的每個搜尋引擎的隱私權政策。
zh-TW.risk: SearXNG 要連到公開網路上的許多搜尋引擎，所以你的搜尋關鍵字會離開這個叢集。

risks.mitigation: The template does not limit outbound traffic. Read the privacy policy of each search engine you turn on.
risks.risk: SearXNG must reach many search engines on the public Internet, so your search terms leave this cluster.

zh-CN.mitigation: 如果你改过代码，或者提供给其他人使用，按许可要求公开对应的源代码。
zh-CN.risk: SearXNG 采用 AGPL-3.0-or-later 许可。

zh-TW.mitigation: 如果你改過程式碼，或是提供給其他人使用，依授權要求公開對應的原始碼。
zh-TW.risk: SearXNG 採用 AGPL-3.0-or-later 授權。

risks.mitigation: If you change the code or offer it to other users, publish the matching source code as the license requires.

security.summary: SearXNG runs without root rights, with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and no extra Linux capabilities. Only Traefik can reach it, over HTTPS. Outbound traffic is not limited.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: searxng
  namespace: {{ .Namespace }}
data:
  settings.yml: |
    use_default_settings: true
    general:
      instance_name: SearXNG
    server:
      bind_address: 0.0.0.0
      port: 8080
      base_url: https://{{ .Domain }}/
      limiter: false
      public_instance: false
      image_proxy: true
    search:
      formats: [html, json]
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: searxng
  namespace: {{ .Namespace }}
spec:
  replicas: 1
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy: {type: Recreate}
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: searxng}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: searxng, templates.zeabur.com/template: searxng}
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 977
        runAsGroup: 977
        fsGroup: 977
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}
      containers:
        - name: searxng
          image: searxng/searxng:2026.10.24-ef0ec03da@sha256:7c7cbe509429e82755104b2a95f52085a98633c95d53f44e4e905fa3a59f08c8
          env:
            - {name: SEARXNG_BASE_URL, value: 'https://{{ .Domain }}/'}
            - name: SEARXNG_SECRET
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef: {name: app-secrets, key: signing-key}
            - {name: FORCE_OWNERSHIP, value: 'false'}
            - {name: GRANIAN_HOST, value: '0.0.0.0'}
          ports: [{name: http, containerPort: 8080}]
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}
          resources:
            requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 256Mi}
            limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1Gi}
          startupProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: http}
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 60
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: http}
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: http}
            periodSeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 6
          volumeMounts:
            - {name: config, mountPath: /etc/searxng, readOnly: true}
            - {name: cache, mountPath: /var/cache/searxng}
            - {name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp}
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap: {name: searxng}
        - name: cache
          emptyDir: {sizeLimit: 256Mi}
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {sizeLimit: 128Mi}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: searxng
  namespace: {{ .Namespace }}
spec:
  selector: {app.kubernetes.io/name: searxng}
  ports: [{name: http, port: 8080, targetPort: http}]
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: searxng
  namespace: {{ .Namespace }}
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: {{ .ClusterIssuer }}
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
    - hosts: [{{ .Domain }}]
      secretName: searxng-tls
  rules:
    - host: {{ .Domain }}
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: searxng
                port: {name: http}
